import cohere
import numpy as np

def similarity_score(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    co = cohere.Client(os.environ.get("COHERE_API_KEY"))
    texts = [payload["text1"], payload["text2"]]
    response = co.embed(
        texts=texts,
        model='embed-english-v3.0',
        input_type='search_document'
    )
    v1 = np.array(response.embeddings[0])
    v2 = np.array(response.embeddings[1])
    
    dot_product = np.dot(v1, v2)
    norm_v1 = np.linalg.norm(v1)
    norm_v2 = np.linalg.norm(v2)
    result = dot_product / (norm_v1 * norm_v2)
    return result
